stats.cohort: YC W26 / founded 2024–2026, firm-level sources only

newcos.activity_evidence: Sits on warehouse-management, transportation-management and ERP systems and turns that data into supply-chain planning and execution decisions: routing, scheduling and resource allocation under hard operational constraints.
newcos.bridge: A logistics decision layer, not a new retailer. The work already lives in fulfillment networks.

newcos.activity_evidence: Builds task-specific simulation environments for robot policies on material-handling and manufacturing assembly work such as textiles and box folding, so teams can train and evaluate manipulation without being limited by physical robot time.
newcos.bridge: Warehouse manipulation is already the staffing story inside store-network and fulfillment firms.

newcos.activity_evidence: Designs a high-degree-of-freedom robotic hand and matching data-collection device so manipulation policies trained on factory and logistics-center work can be deployed on the same hardware.
newcos.bridge: Dexterous picking is a line of work already staffed on fulfillment floors and assembly lines.

newcos.activity_evidence: Operates as a licensed commercial insurance brokerage whose operations layer submits applications, chases underwriters, issues certificates and re-shops renewals for hard-to-place risks in construction, trucking, energy and manufacturing.
newcos.bridge: Brokerage operations are the same claims-and-placement work already running at listed insurers.

newcos.activity_evidence: Automates inventory and contents processing for insurance carriers, public adjusters and restoration firms, including adjacent estimating workflows that currently consume large amounts of claims labor.
newcos.bridge: Contents inventory is a claims step, not a grocery step, even though the word is inventory.

newcos.activity_evidence: Runs low-latency routing and execution software so a single market view can be turned into a trade across crypto exchanges, prediction markets and tokenized-asset venues, with execution reporting on the resulting fills.
newcos.bridge: Venue-to-venue execution is the same transaction-processing work capital-markets desks already do.

newcos.activity_evidence: Helps mortgage lenders originate loans by pulling borrower documents, checking eligibility, flagging missing or conflicting files, and assembling complete packages for loan officers.
newcos.bridge: Origination intake is already a named capability at listed mortgage platforms.

neighbors.name: Citi · Personal Banking and Wealth Management

newcos.activity_evidence: Acts as a custom-silicon design partner on mature nodes for power electronics, covering architecture through verification, fabrication, packaging and production-ready parts for motor drives, battery systems, EV charging, solar and grid conversion.
newcos.bridge: Custom silicon for power is the same design-and-fab work the listed chip firms already run.

newcos.activity_evidence: Builds automotive radar hardware that exposes raw sensor data, plus a radar simulator, so mass-market vehicles can train end-to-end autonomy stacks on cameras and radar together instead of lidar.
newcos.bridge: Vehicle sensing is an OEM and tier-one line of work, not a generic software category.

newcos.activity_evidence: Deploys robots that plug electric and autonomous fleet vehicles into existing chargers, confirm charge initiation, and run post-trip inspections so depots can turn vehicles without a manual charging crew.

newcos.activity_evidence: Engineers modular autonomous strike and ISR drones with swappable payloads and an agentic control system, currently shipping prototypes with UK and other NATO units.
newcos.bridge: Unmanned strike and sensing is already inside listed aerospace-and-defense programs.

newcos.activity_evidence: Builds procurement software for large electricity consumers — commercial and industrial sites and data centers — to forecast load, hedge, budget power-purchase agreements and steer on-site generation and storage.
newcos.bridge: Power procurement is the energy firm's work, even when the buyer is a retailer or a compute campus.

newcos.activity_evidence: Gives grid operators a single versioned model of substations and lines with evidence attached, so planning, connections and network-change decisions are not spread across spreadsheets and static reports.
newcos.bridge: Network planning is already how regulated energy and infrastructure firms run the grid.

newcos.activity_evidence: Runs outsourced medical billing and revenue-cycle work for providers, starting with ambulance claims: insurance calls, documentation checks, benefit verification and collections on claims that traditional billers skip.
newcos.bridge: Revenue-cycle operations sit next to listed health systems and insurers, not next to a generic AI lab.

newcos.activity_evidence: Automates end-to-end prior authorization for private medical practices so authorizations are submitted faster and with fewer denials than the in-house process.
newcos.bridge: Prior-auth is a claims workflow already staffed inside listed providers and payers.

newcos.activity_evidence: Automates prior authorization, copay-assistance enrollment and related admin for biologic infusion clinics, turning a process that spans dozens of payer portals and paper forms into one workflow so clinics are reimbursed for high-cost specialty drugs.
newcos.bridge: Infusion-clinic operations are care delivery plus pharmacy-benefit work, already on the listed health-system map.

newcos.activity_evidence: Replaces the spreadsheet-and-email patchwork contractors use to run a job: takeoffs, estimates, proposals, change orders, permits and photos live in one project record from first bid to final invoice.
newcos.bridge: Job-site administration is the same program-management work listed engineering and homebuilding firms already staff.

newcos.activity_evidence: Operates as an immigration law firm that drafts work-visa petition narratives, compiles evidence and routes every filing through licensed attorney review, covering O-1, H-1B, L-1, TN, EB-1 and EB-2 NIW categories.
newcos.bridge: Petition production is professional-services delivery, the same mode as listed advisory firms.

newcos.activity_evidence: Provides a collaborative production workspace for professional filmmaking with generative video models: camera-controlled shots, a timeline for assemblies, and team sharing of edits so commercials and films can be directed rather than prompted.
newcos.bridge: Shot production is content operations already running at listed entertainment firms, even when the camera is a model.
